description: Inbound messages to a software company's sales inbox.

lead_quality.instructions: How qualified is this sales lead?

cases.state: Hi, I'm the VP of Engineering at a 400-person logistics company. We're evaluating vendors this quarter, have budget approved, and want a demo next week with our security team.
Hi, I'm a student working on a class project about project management tools. Do you have a free version?
Just browsing your website. Do you send a newsletter?
We're a 12-person startup looking for a tool like yours. We'll decide sometime in the next six months. Can you send some information?
Our team of 80 needs to replace our current tool before our contract ends next month. Can we get a demo this week?
Please remove me from all of your mailing lists.
I saw your product on a conference stage. Interesting. Maybe later this year we'll take a look.
I'm the head of operations at a 1,000-person retailer. We're comparing three vendors and want a call with your team on Thursday.
Does your software run on Mac? Our team of five is thinking about trying it.
I'm selling search-ranking services. Can I get 10 minutes of your time to show you how to rank higher?
We have a pilot planned for next quarter with a budget already set aside. Can your team present to our steering group?
We tried your product last year and stopped using it. Has anything changed?
